notes.title: Our Biggest Discount Yet for the Steam Summer Sale!
notes.notes: [p]The Steam Summer Sale is here, and the vampires of [i]Fledgling Manor [/i]need your help! With long days come short nights, which can be a problem when sunlight causes you to burst into flames. To give our contestants a hand, [i]Fledgling Manor [/i]is 50% off until the Steam Summer Sale ends — our deepest discount yet! Plus, here's a new piece from our artist Shaydh featuring our protagonist, Rocky. Stay cool, everybody![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216321/67ea9ed78d06ae9977c7f0934e0e9b244caae794.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Fledgling Manor Version 1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
We've just updated Fledgling Manor to version 1.1! Thanks for all your support.

Version 1.1 Patch Notes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where music would sometimes continue playing during episode title cards
[*] Added missing sound effects to episode title cards
[*] Changed hover-over text effect in menus as previous one was causing unintentional wobble
[*] Added unique portraits for some recurring characters, swapping out the silhouettes
[/list]

notes.title: Fledgling Manor is out now!
notes.notes:
Fledgling Manor is on sale today at a release discount of 15%! We've had a great time making it and we hope you have a wonderful time playing it too.
